description: Same as find_trips_near but the time window is given as epoch milliseconds (since_ms, until_ms) instead of ISO dates. Use this when find_trips_near rejects the date parameters. Returns truck_id, the ping time and the distance in meters, nearest first.

configuration.query: FROM telematics_log | WHERE at_ms >= ?since_ms AND at_ms <= ?until_ms | EVAL dist_m = ST_DISTANCE(location, TO_GEOPOINT(?point_wkt)) | WHERE dist_m < ?radius_m | SORT dist_m ASC | KEEP truck_id, at, dist_m | LIMIT 20

since_ms.description: Window start as epoch milliseconds UTC, e.g. 1787833800000

until_ms.description: Window end as epoch milliseconds UTC, e.g. 1787839200000
